items.title: Suno introduces Visuals: turn songs into video clips, lyric videos and artwork
items.excerpt: Suno launched Visuals, which turns songs made on Suno into a video clip, a lyrics video or a visual world for the track, ready to share.

history_match.title: Disney has fought AI firms over copyright. Now it's testing AI lyric videos.

items.title: Suno Moves Into AI Filmmaking With New Product 'Visuals'
items.excerpt: Billboard reports Suno is moving into AI filmmaking with Visuals, a product that generates videos and images to accompany songs made on its platform.

history_match.title: Nvidia Moves to Quash Burdensome UMG v. Suno Subpoena

items.title: Spotify expands Artist Profile Protection so all artists can remove their name from AI fakes and misattributed releases
items.excerpt: Spotify opened Artist Profile Protection, launched in beta in March, to all artists, letting them review new releases under their name and remove AI fakes and other misattributed tracks before they appear on their profiles.

items.title: Spotify's new tool aims to stop deepfakes from being attributed to real artists
items.excerpt: All Spotify artists can now use Artist Profile Protection to vet releases under their names; the move follows Billboard's report that Sony Music had requested removal of more than 260,000 deepfake songs.

history_match.title: Spotify DJ gets new voices, and the ability to stop yammering

items.title: Tencent Music says AI content streams are 'negligible' as it takes legal action over AI infringement
items.excerpt: Tencent Music says streams of AI-generated content are 'negligible' and declining as a share of listening, as it takes legal action over AI infringement.

items.title: Universal and Sony fight Suno's bid to freeze second lawsuit, warning its latest AI models could escape scrutiny until 2028
items.excerpt: The labels offered to defer proving ownership of more than 60,000 recordings but want discovery into how Suno v6 was trained to begin now, opposing Suno's request to pause the second suit.

history_match.title: Suno admits it has not deleted all the recordings used to train its AI, in answer to UMG and Sony's 'laundering' lawsuit

items.title: Universal Music v. Suno II Intensifies Amid Discovery Sub-Dispute
items.excerpt: The major labels and Suno are clashing over the scope of discovery in the second Universal Music v. Suno case, including access to the company's newer models.

items.title: iZotope launches AI-powered stem separation and audio enhancement plug-in, Photon
items.excerpt: iZotope's new Photon plug-in uses AI for stem separation and audio enhancement, including restoration that tames outdoor wind, traffic and indoor room noise.

history_match.title: iZotope Photon is a local stem separation and denoising tool that runs off your GPU

items.title: Deezer report finds shrinking belief that fully-AI music will be popular
items.excerpt: Deezer's second annual survey of attitudes to AI-generated music, run with Ipsos across 9,000 people, finds shrinking belief that fully AI-made music will become popular.

items.title: 72% of music streaming users want more transparency on AI music, study finds
items.excerpt: In Deezer's survey, almost three-quarters of listeners believed they had no AI-generated music in their playlists, although 57% of respondents did.

items.title: A.I.Radio includes 'a DJ you can talk to and request songs from'
items.excerpt: Music Ally looks at A.I.Radio, an AI radio experiment that includes a DJ listeners can talk to and request songs from.

items.title: TuneArt is an indie AI-music-video maker with a pay-as-you-go model
items.excerpt: TuneArt lets artists generate music videos with AI without a subscription, charging pay-as-you-go instead.

items.title: SoundCloud CEO Talks AI Policies: 'Wishing Away the Advent of AI Music Is Not a Strategy'
items.excerpt: SoundCloud CEO Eliah Seton details new partnerships with ElevenLabs and Moises and the platform's AI policies.

history_match.title: ElevenLabs now lets users publish AI-generated music directly on SoundCloud

items.title: Berlin's largest electronic music venue, now a stage for debuting military AI
items.excerpt: Berlin Kraftwerk, the former power plant tied to Tresor and Atonal, hosted defence firm Helsing's launch of its agentic AI platform Clarity last week.

items.title: UK Music Urges Government Action on AI, Brexit and Funding
items.excerpt: UK Music's This Is Music report puts the industry's 2025 GVA at a record GBP 8.4bn and calls for government action on AI copyright protections.

history_match.title: With artificial intelligence on COP31 agenda, IMPALA calls for action on AI and sustainability

items.title: How an AI Content Mill Put a Real Musician Through Copyright Hell
items.excerpt: A company founded last year, running a network of some 500 YouTube channels, claimed copyright over a musician's five-year-old folk recording and got her video removed; two appeals were rejected before it was restored.

history_match.title: More YouTube creators can now use AI to replace copyrighted songs

items.title: ALS Singer Sings Again via Brain Signals and AI
items.excerpt: A University of California team decoded brain signals so that a singer with ALS could speak and sing again in real time; wireless use is still pending.
